risk_if_not_implemented: Without Detonation Chambers (Sandboxes), security incidents may not be detected, contained, investigated or communicated in a timely manner, increasing their scope, duration and cost. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to System / Data Compromise (Technical Vector) (R-BC-4), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Network Segmentation (macrosegmentation)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to implement network segmentation within network architectures to isolate Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) from other network resources.
compensating_control_1.justification: Network Segmentation (macrosegmentation) (NET-06) provides network-level access restriction that compensates for the absence of Detonation Chambers (Sandboxes) (IRO-21) by limiting attacker reach and lateral movement opportunities across the environment. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Malicious Code Protection (Antimalware)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize antimalware, or similar technologies, to detect and eradicate malicious code.
compensating_control_2.justification: Malicious Code Protection (Antimalware) (END-04) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Detonation Chambers (Sandboxes) (IRO-21) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
